new_mechanisms.prior_and_object_difference: Checkpoint/recompute is known; the object difference is exact current-batch dynamic BN1 behind a highly sparse H67 FC1 producer. Instead of retaining the BN1 raw FC1 output, pass 1 computes moments and discards raw, and pass 2 deterministically recomputes FC1 then streams affine->ATLIF. The claim would be a resource trade, not a new normalization formula. BN2 is outside the first fast-kill because its producer and residual boundary differ.
new_mechanisms.mathematical_protocol_basis: If FC1 and moment reduction use a frozen fixed-point order, recomputed x is bit-identical; BN(x; mean(x),var(x)) is unchanged. The mechanism exchanges raw write+replay bytes for one extra FC1 execution and weight traffic, preserving the global barrier.
new_mechanisms.same_resource_baseline: M480 fair strong fused raw replay plus the same M481/K8 producer lanes, weight banks, Acc24 precision, bandwidth and consumer; candidate gets no extra ports or free weight residency.
new_mechanisms.one_day_cpu_fast_kill: Address-time both BN1 schedules at 32/64/128 B/cycle using the 100 FC1 records. Require zero numeric/ordering mismatch and either >=1.15x total FC1+BN1 exposed cycles at a declared realistic point or >=30% DRAM-byte reduction with >=1.20x EDP proxy. Charge the second FC1 issue, weights, moments and all barriers. Otherwise KILL.
new_mechanisms.minimal_rtl_slice_if_go: one FC1 tile with moments-only pass/replay selector and direct affine->ATLIF handoff; no full wrapper, no new multiplier array
new_mechanisms.unpriced_risk: At 64--128 B/cycle the extra FC1 work may cost more than raw replay, so a fast negative result is plausible.

new_mechanisms.prior_and_object_difference: DeltaCNN/DeltaRNN-style temporal deltas are prior art. The H67 object difference is exact binary/scaled-binary K3/S2 polyphase ConvTranspose feeding analog ATLIF/residual state. The candidate emits XOR-derived signed tap deltas through M522/M523/C2 and updates a named downstream state, avoiding inserted zeros and, only if proven, a separate previous-output store.
new_mechanisms.mathematical_protocol_basis: For the linear deconvolution core, y_t = y_(t-1) + W*(x_t-x_(t-1)); x_t-x_(t-1) is {-1,0,+1} for exact binary inputs. Bias is applied at initialization/resynchronization only. D1 requires the runtime-theta scaling identity. Any nonlinear/BN/concat boundary breaks the bridge unless an explicit bit-exact state mapping is proved.
new_mechanisms.same_resource_baseline: Exact M672 polyphase A1/K8 with 96 arithmetic lanes, 8-source peak, Acc24, identical weight ports, 240 KiB local budget and all prior-input/prior-output/downstream-state bytes charged. No free persistent output SRAM.
new_mechanisms.one_day_cpu_fast_kill: First prove an exact downstream-state identity. Then derive per-timestep delta tap/product counts from M705 bitpacks. Require delta_product/A1_product <0.70 before memory and address-timed total >=1.20x after prior-input, resync, state RMW and dense commit. If the bridge still needs the 20.215/30.322 MiB prior-output state or any D1 mismatch, KILL before RTL.
new_mechanisms.minimal_rtl_slice_if_go: XOR edge descriptor generator plus signed polyphase tap bundler and epoch/resync checker reusing the existing C2 input protocol; no new Conv matcher/scheduler
new_mechanisms.unpriced_risk: Cross-sequence density stability does not imply temporal delta sparsity, and the downstream nonlinear boundary may make the state bridge impossible.

no_third_mechanism_reason: C1, C2, C3, FC1, RQTB and decoder currently have validation/physical-admission gaps, not an unoccupied arithmetic lower-bound gap. Patch and PDR are measured failures. Opening a third mechanism would be mechanism sprawl or a fourth generic Conv matcher.
